name: tradrl-adapters-jax-lob
description: The JAX-LOB training adapter (W049) — the LOB-venue TRAINING ADAPTER over the W047 TrainerPort/episode-batch contracts and the W048 GenerationPlan/GenerationWorkerPort contracts. CLEAN-ROOM, paper-based (spec/THIRD-PARTY-TECHNOLOGY-REGISTER.md, the binding JAX-LOB ruling): zero code derived from KangOxford/jax-lob or KangOxford/AlphaTrade — only the publicly documented concepts of a limit-order-book training environment family, re-expressed as original TypeScript. lob-vocabulary.ts declares the closed LOB training vocabulary (book-state descriptors with sides/levels as data, order kinds, execution event kinds, episode-step shapes) — fail-closed at every seam. lob-trainer.ts projects a W047 episode/batch to LOB-style training steps as PURE typed data (deterministic projection, canonical order, content-addressed lobtrain- ids; W047's own validation errors carried verbatim). lob-generation.ts projects a W048 generation plan to LOB-style environment declarations (W048's whole-plan re-validation errors carried verbatim). A14: the adapter COMPOSES typed data — never trains, never executes simulation steps, never imports or forks third-party code. A9 throughout: no clocks, no randomness, no env reads.
